instruction: A candid medium full shot of a grassy park on a sunny day. In the foreground, a large Black man in a black t-shirt (R1) stands in profile facing right, with his arms extended forward as if he has just thrown a disc. In the background, a woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6) stands on the left watching, while an Asian man in a red polo (R3) walks on the right. Natural daylight illuminates the green grass and trees.
